verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is fundamentally an AI-native prompt-driven builder: users build apps, edit code, add databases, deploy, and even manage security fixes via natural-language chat with an agent, with community reports confirming '99% of edits made through prompts' and full apps built from idea to prod via chat. Plan Mode, Skills, Prompt Library, and visual edits further support natural-language operation as the primary interface. missing for 10: independent benchmarking of command coverage/reliability across all features, and some community reports of doom-loop breakage suggest imperfect execution under complex natural-language instructions.
